title: UMbusi Owayefuna UbuNkulunkulu
intro: Umbusi onamandla nozikhukhumezayo wayekholelwa ukuthi akekho owayemi ngaphezu kwesihlalo sakhe sobukhosi. Baxosha iqembu elalibaleka emanzini amaningi, kodwa bagcina befike esiphelweni esimangalisayo. Indaba yalo mbusi izwakala ezindimeni eziningi zeQuran, isebenza njengesixwayiso kubo bonke.
clues: Ngangingumbusi onamandla owayekholelwa ukuthi akukho gunya elidlula elami emazweni engangiwabusa.
Nganginomuntu owayengithemba ogama lakhe linguHaman owangisiza ekwenzeni imisebenzi emikhulu yokwakha.
Ngabiza izangoma ezinhle kakhulu ezweni lakithi ukuze zingiphonsele inselelo ngezibonakaliso zesithunywa esingiphikisayo.
Ngenqaba ukuvumela abantu ababeyizigqila embusweni wami bahambe, naphezu kwezifo nezixwayiso ezicacile.
Ngabaxosha ngaphesheya kolwandle olukhulu nebutho lami lonke nezinqola zami.
Lolo lwandle lwangisibekela mina namabutho ami, lwasicwilisa sonke, ngesikhathi bewela ngokuphepha.

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: Ngiphinde ngahlangana nomndeni wami ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi yobunzima

arabic: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
verse: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy. (51:40)
